title: DOL motor with start/stop
summary: Conveyor CV-3: a 2.2 kW motor on a direct-on-line starter with 24 V DC control, RUN and TRIP lamps.
brief:
**Client:** Riverside bottling plant (fictional).
**Equipment:** crate conveyor **CV-3**, 2.2 kW 4-pole motor, 400 V, nameplate FLC 4.6 A.

The line supervisor wants a local start/stop station at the conveyor and lamps on the panel door.

**Scope**
- Motor circuit breaker **Q1**, contactor **KM1**, overload relay **F2** set to nameplate FLC.
- 24 V DC control from **G1**, protected by MCB **F1**, fed from after Q1.
- STOP (NC) and START (NO) push buttons, holding contact, RUN lamp **H1**, TRIP lamp **H2**.
- No automatic restart after an overload reset or a power cut.

**Deliverables:** wired and tested starter, completed test sheet, marked-up drawing.

ioList.type: 3 main poles, aux 13-14 and 43-44 NO, 21-22 NC; 24 V DC coil
ioList.connection: Coil A1 from F2:96, A2 to G1 −
95-96 in series with KM1 coil; 97-98 lights H2
U1 V1 W1 from F2 2/4/6, PE to earth bar

logic.condition: START pressed, STOP not pressed, F2 not tripped
logic.action: KM1 pulls in, motor runs, H1 lights
KM1 drops out, motor coasts to rest, H1 off
95-96 opens: KM1 drops out. 97-98 closes: H2 lights
Motor stays off until START is pressed again

schedule.step: Isolation, lock off and prove dead at the supply
Mount Q1, KM1, F2, F1, G1 on DIN rail; fit door devices
Wire power circuit and motor cable; terminate PE
Wire 24 V control circuit and lamps; ferrules and labels
Dead tests: continuity, insulation resistance, polarity; record
Set F2 to 4.6 A; energise; functional test with supervisor
Mark up drawing, complete test sheet, hand over

testIntro: Run the starter and record each result, as you would on a real test sheet. Start each row from the state it describes (press STOP or reset F2 first where needed).

testSheet.text: Press and release START. Is KM1 energised?
Motor running current once up to speed
Motor speed once up to speed
Voltage at the motor, U1 to V1, while running
Run the motor, then press TEST on F2. Is TRIP lamp H2 lit?
Then press RESET on F2. Is KM1 energised (did it restart by itself)?

faults.report: The wire from KM1 44 to RUN lamp H1 is broken: the motor runs but H1 stays off.
KM1 main pole 3-4 is open: the motor gets two phases and stalls.
The wire from S2 terminal 14 to KM1 terminal 14 is broken: START works only while held.
TRIP lamp H2 has failed (open filament or LED).

faultChecks.fail: KM1 does not stay in after START.
RUN lamp H1 is off while running.
TRIP lamp H2 is off after an overload trip.

extraReports: Nothing is wrong: the starter works as specified.
modelAnswer:
**Test sheet:** START pulls in and holds KM1. Running current about **4.6 A** (the nameplate FLC). Speed **1430 rpm**. U1 to V1 **400 V**. Overload TEST: KM1 drops out and H2 lights. After RESET the motor stays off until START is pressed.

**Fault notes:** a motor that hums and will not start points to a missing phase: measure across each pole of Q1, KM1 and F2 in turn with the starter on (or check continuity with it isolated). A lamp that stays off: measure across the lamp first; voltage across it means the lamp has failed, no voltage means the feed or return is broken.

**Handover:** record Q1 and F2 settings, IR and continuity results, and the date of the test on the test sheet.
schematicIntro: The working starter. Press START and STOP, try the overload TEST and RESET, and watch the event log.
